name: vault-transcripts
description: Rename, clean, and summarize voice-note and meeting transcripts in an Obsidian vault inbox while preserving the original transcription verbatim.

tools.name: vault_transcripts
tools.description: Process raw transcripts in an Obsidian vault inbox: classify owner material, personal exchanges, external sources, and unknown material; apply scoped voice only where valid; add type-aware cleanup, summaries, and owner-journal reflection; and keep the original transcription under '# Transcript'. Runs are dry-run by default and inspectable with status/doctor.
